_status: PROVISIONAL — derived from NDCH_017. Do not promote to invariant until tested across at least 3 reels.
_law: Levels derive from rules. Rules derive from the doctrine's emotional temperature. Never mix by ear alone — mix until the audio satisfies the same validation philosophy as every other artifact.
description: sound_direction is a first-class artifact in script.json. It defines the audio architecture for a reel: the music's role, the cinematic hierarchy of layers, the dynamic profile per narrative section, and the function of silence. The Compiler reads this alongside voice_direction to generate the editorial_timeline and configure the mastering chain.

music_role.description: The music's single primary function. Determines how it is mixed against the voice. 'continuity' = music provides thread between beats; 'tension' = music escalates toward pivot; 'atmosphere' = music sets emotional temperature only; 'counter-melody' = music has independent melodic identity; 'punctuation' = music marks structural beats only.

emotional_temperature.description: Qualitative descriptors for the sonic identity of the reel. These constrain track selection and EQ choices. Not levels — temperature.

anti_descriptors.description: What this reel must NOT sound like. Enforced during track selection.

cinematic_layers.description: The three-layer hierarchy. Levels are relative, not absolute. Absolute levels are resolved by the mastering preset.

layer_1_philosophy.character: Never strained. Never shouting. Almost conversational. Documentary narrator, not trailer narrator.

layer_2_atmosphere.character: Answers one question: what emotional temperature does this doctrine exist in?

layer_3_space.character: Silence between voice and music is not empty. It is carrying meaning. Each silence window must have a declared function.
layer_3_space.priority: structural — must be intentional, never accidental

dynamic_profile.description: Per-section rules. Levels derive from these rules, not the other way around. The Compiler maps these to editorial_timeline.json regions.

item_schema.section: string — matches segment beat_label in script.json segments
item_schema.music_directive: string — qualitative + optional relative dB adjustment
item_schema.relationship: string — describes how voice and music coexist in this section

017_instance.relationship: voice establishes doctrine; music marks entry only

017_instance.music_directive: slightly rising — +0 to +1 dB on breathing pauses
017_instance.relationship: music surfaces into silence windows between accumulated beats
voice receives maximum cognitive space; music recedes completely

017_instance.music_directive: recover — return to reference level over ignition dwell
017_instance.relationship: music has arrived before resolution is spoken; doctrine and atmosphere are now unified

017_instance.music_directive: carry ending — rise +1 dB into visual tail, decay to near-silence at reel end
017_instance.voice_directive: decay — voice exits, music holds the final image
017_instance.relationship: music owns the visual tail; doctrine settles into silence

silence_function.description: Declares the function of each class of silence window. Silence is never empty — it is a scored beat.

017_instance.breath_pause: Viewer receives the previous line. Music surfaces at ambient level. Duration: 600-900ms.
017_instance.pivot_dwell: Correction has landed. Viewer processes the cognitive shift. Music holds the space. Duration: 850ms.
017_instance.ignition_dwell: Central claim has landed. Emotional transfer. Music is at its most present before the voice returns. Duration: 1200ms.
017_instance.fragmentation_pause: Between accumulated fragments — mirrors the accumulation mechanism. Music barely audible. Duration: 275-350ms.
017_instance.visual_tail: Narration has ended. Music owns the frame. Doctrine settles. Duration: 7s+.
017_instance.final_decay: Möbius close. Music recedes with the visual. Viewer exits into silence.

mastering_preset_id.description: Reference to a named preset in assets/mastering/. The preset defines the full technical chain. Override only if the doctrine's emotional temperature requires a different chain.

usage_in_script_json.placement: Top-level block in script.json, alongside voice_direction

sound_direction.silence_function: restrained — each pause receives music at ambient level only

promotion_status.promotion_condition: Schema fields are stable across reels with different physical vocabularies and emotional temperatures. No field needs to be added or removed for 018, 019.
promotion_status.do_not_promote_if: A reel requires adding fields that don't generalize — that means the schema needs expansion, not freezing.
